Name: Slime Hutch Upgrades
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[b]Slime Hutch Upgrades[/b] adds two new upgrades to Stardew Valley’s Slime Hutch, letting you expand from the vanilla building into a [b]Big Slime Hutch[/b] and eventually a [b]Deluxe Slime Hutch[/b]. ✨

Bigger buildings. Bigger interiors. More troughs. More incubators.
And, most importantly...
[b]more slime.[/b] 🟢

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]✨ [b]MOD FEATURES[/b] ✨[/size]

🏠 [b]Two new Slime Hutch upgrades![/b]
Upgrade your vanilla Slime Hutch into a [b]Big Slime Hutch[/b], then take things one step further with the [b]Deluxe Slime Hutch[/b].

🟢 [b]Expanded slime capacity![/b]
Each tier supports progressively more slimes:

🐣 [b]Slime Hutch:[/b] 20 slimes

💚 [b]Big Slime Hutch:[/b] 40 slimes

✨ [b]Deluxe Slime Hutch:[/b] 60 slimes

Your slime ranching ambitions no longer need to fit inside one tiny purple rectangle.

📐 [b]Larger exterior footprints![/b]
The upgraded hutches actually grow with their increased capacity instead of somehow stuffing 60 slimes into the original building.

🚪 [b]Expanded interiors![/b]
Both upgrades come with larger interior maps designed to give your increasingly ridiculous slime population some breathing room.

💧 [b]Expanded watering troughs![/b]
The upgraded interiors include additional trough space built for their larger slime populations.

🥚 [b]Extra Slime Incubators![/b]
Larger hutches give you more built-in incubators to help fill all that new space, with the Deluxe Slime Hutch featuring [b]three incubators[/b].

🪑 [b]A little Deluxe flair![/b]
The Deluxe interior isn’t all business. There are a few extra decorative touches to make your fully upgraded slime empire feel a little more lived-in.

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]🏠 [b]THE UPGRADES[/b] 🏠[/size]

Your Slime Hutch now has a full three-tier progression:

🐣 [b]SLIME HUTCH[/b]
The vanilla building you already know and love.

Capacity: [b]20 slimes[/b]

⬇️

💚 [b]BIG SLIME HUTCH[/b]
A larger build with enough room to support [b]40 slimes[/b].

More space. More troughs. More slime-related business decisions.

⬇️

✨ [b]DELUXE SLIME HUTCH[/b]
The final upgrade, built for farmers who looked at 40 slimes and decided restraint was for other people.

Capacity: [b]60 slimes[/b]

The Deluxe Hutch features expanded slime infrastructure, multiple incubators, and a few extra decorative touches.

At this point you are less of a farmer and more of a regional slime distributor.

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]🔨 [b]HOW TO UPGRADE[/b] 🔨[/size]

Start with a normal [b]Slime Hutch[/b] on your farm.

Then visit [b]Robin’s Carpenter Shop[/b] and browse her building options.

Once you own the required previous tier, Robin will offer the next upgrade:

🐣 Slime Hutch
➡️ 💚 Big Slime Hutch
➡️ ✨ Deluxe Slime Hutch
[center][/center]
[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]📥 [b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b] 📥[/size]

You’ll need:

🌱 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b]

🔧 [b]SMAPI[/b]

🧩 [b]Content Patcher 2.0+[/b]

[b]👣  Building Footprint Swapper[/b]

Install all included mod folders directly inside your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder, then launch the game through SMAPI.

Once everything loads, head over to Robin and begin your descent into industrialized slime ranching. 🟢✨

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]🧩 [b]COMPATIBILITY NOTES[/b] 🧩[/size]

Slime Hutch Upgrades changes several parts of the Slime Hutch in order to create proper building upgrades, including:

🏠 Building definitions and footprints

🗺️ Slime Hutch interior maps

🟢 Maximum slime capacity

💧 Slime Hutch trough behavior

🔨 Carpenter Shop upgrade behavior and previews

💬 Robin’s construction dialogue

Mods that heavily replace the Slime Hutch building, its interior maps, its capacity rules, or Robin’s Slime Hutch construction entries may require a compatibility patch.

The troughs use vanilla-compatible behavior and [b]do not require Slime Hutch Water Spots[/b].

Compatibility patch requests are welcome! 💕

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[size=4]🎮 [b]MULTIPLAYER NOTE[/b] 🎮[/size]

For multiplayer farms, installing the mod for [b]all players[/b] is required so everyone has the same building maps, capacities, and Slime Hutch behavior. The host should handle Slime Hutch construction and upgrades through Robin for the smoothest experience.

[center]🐸━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🐸[/center]

[b][size=4]📸 PROMO IMAGE CREDITS[/size][/b]
